parser.baseline: IsValid checked only dimensions/nonempty/offsets. FromJson narrowed values before admission and accepted arbitrary versions/enums; Rotate/Mirror used TrackToTrackdir without validation. This is source evidence, not an executed old-binary comparison.
parser.change: Shared IsValid, typed integers before narrowing, bounded byte/depth/schema/metadata/array admission, SAX duplicate-key rejection, exact track/signal compatibility, guarded transforms.
parser.evidence: Three new parser CTests plus invalid-signal255 GUI import rejection; all previous transforms/128 prefab placements and persistence pass.
parser.compatibility: Existing serializer-produced v1 retained. Unknown versions, missing required shape fields, oversized/invalid metadata reject; no existing files rewritten.

storage.baseline: Save truncated destination directly and ignored final stream errors; rename deleted old file first and changed memory before saving. Filenames rederived from names could collide or point at the wrong file. Export GUI only created a local JSON string and Import only rescanned.
storage.change: Actual source paths per row, temporary writes and checked flush/close, atomic replacement/no-clobber publication, same-file metadata rename, bounded reads, collision policies and error reporting. New imports do not overwrite an existing player name.
storage.evidence: Six storage CTests plus six real fault-injected processes and three real GUI query cases. Each failed write/commit checks old bytes, memory, reopened data and retry.
storage.compatibility: Keeps FioFindDirectory then personal-directory fallback, preserving existing XDG/search roots. Invalid files retained; default export outside scan. Windows wrappers included and reviewed but not run.

gui.change: Explicit pending query kind/snapshot; import/export real paths; export current transformed model; cancellation and accurate success/failure text; scan errors reported on opening.
gui.verification: Native window, editbox query and OK/cancel callbacks with null video/mock sprites/fonts; no visual rendering acceptance. Hidden Catch cases explicitly registered as isolated CTests.

out_of_scope: WP-07 capture drag/cancel/naming and route topology
Library mass migration or user-file deletion
